file_description: Fracture/Completion Data - Hydraulic fracturing job details for unconventional wells
data_format: WIDE format - one row per fracture job
use_case: Completion intensity metrics, proppant loading, pressure/horsepower requirements for Vaca Muerta shale and tight gas plays

completion_type_descriptions.plug_and_perf: Plug-and-perf - industry standard multi-stage completion. Set bridge plug, perforate casing, pump frac stage, repeat for each stage. Allows precise stage placement. Most common for shale horizontal wells. Enables 10-50+ stages per well.
completion_type_descriptions.sliding_sleeve_multiport: Sliding sleeve - pre-installed mechanical sleeves with ports. Open sleeves sequentially from toe to heel, no perforations needed. Faster operation, less equipment. Limited to simpler completions, 5-15 stages typical.
completion_type_descriptions.hybrid_sleeve_and_perf: Hybrid - combination of sliding sleeves and perforations. Offers flexibility for complex completions. Sleeves for some stages, perforations for others. Balances speed and precision.
completion_type_descriptions.perforation_only: Perforation only - simple single-stage or limited multi-stage completion. Just perforate casing, no plugs or sleeves. Used for conventional wells or simple treatments.
completion_type_descriptions.abrasive_jetting: Abrasive jetting - use high-pressure abrasive slurry to jet through casing. Creates perforation-like holes. Alternative to shaped-charge perforations. Less common, specific applications.

parameter_descriptions.horizontal_lateral_length_m: Length of horizontal section drilled through reservoir. Longer laterals contact more reservoir, enable more frac stages. Vaca Muerta: 1500-3000m typical. US shale: up to 3000-4500m.
parameter_descriptions.fracture_stages_count: Number of discrete hydraulic fracture treatments pumped in well. Each stage creates fracture network in reservoir section. Shale horizontal: 15-50 stages typical. More stages = better reservoir contact but higher cost.
parameter_descriptions.proppant_domestic_tons: Proppant (sand or ceramic) sourced domestically. Keeps fractures open after pumping stops. Measured in metric tons. Argentina produces frac sand domestically but also imports.
parameter_descriptions.proppant_imported_tons: Proppant imported from other countries (often Brazil, USA, China). Higher quality or specific mesh sizes may be imported. Generally more expensive than domestic.
parameter_descriptions.frac_fluid_water_m3: Volume of water-based fluid pumped during hydraulic fracturing. Creates fractures and carries proppant. Typical: 10,000-25,000 m3 per well for shale horizontal. Water sourcing and disposal are key environmental concerns.
parameter_descriptions.frac_fluid_co2_m3: Volume of CO2 injected - used in some fracturing operations instead of or with water. Experimental in Argentina. More common in water-scarce regions or for enhanced recovery.
parameter_descriptions.max_treatment_pressure_psi: Maximum surface pressure during fracturing in pounds per square inch (psi). Indicates fracture pressure and stress state. Typical: 8,000-12,000 psi for shale. Limited by casing burst rating and formation fracture gradient.
parameter_descriptions.frac_equipment_total_horsepower: Total hydraulic horsepower of all pumping units used for frac job. Indicates job size and intensity. Conventional: 5,000-10,000 hp. Shale horizontal: 10,000-50,000 hp. Larger jobs = more pumps, higher rates, more proppant.

calculated_metrics.proppant_intensity_tons_per_m: total_proppant_tons / horizontal_lateral_length_m - KEY METRIC for completion quality. Typical: 0.5-3 tons/m for shale. Higher = more intensive, better production but higher cost.
calculated_metrics.proppant_per_stage_tons: total_proppant_tons / fracture_stages_count - Average proppant per stage. Typical: 50-150 tons/stage for shale.
calculated_metrics.water_per_stage_m3: frac_fluid_water_m3 / fracture_stages_count - Water volume per stage. Typical: 500-1500 m3/stage.
calculated_metrics.stage_spacing_m: horizontal_lateral_length_m / fracture_stages_count - Distance between stages. Typical: 30-60m for shale.
calculated_metrics.frac_duration_days: (frac_end_date - frac_start_date).days - Job duration. Typical: 3-10 days for shale horizontal.
calculated_metrics.is_high_intensity: proppant_intensity_tons_per_m > 0.5 - Binary flag for high-intensity completion

unit_notes.psi: Pounds per square inch - pressure (multiply by 0.0689 for MPa)
unit_notes.hp: Horsepower - hydraulic horsepower (multiply by 0.746 for kW)

technical_notes.completion_evolution: Argentina unconventional completions have intensified over time - more stages, more proppant per foot, higher horsepower. Tracking these trends shows technology advancement.
technical_notes.proppant_importance: Proppant intensity (tons/m) is strongest predictor of well productivity in shale. Higher loading = better production but diminishing returns above ~2.5 tons/m.
technical_notes.vaca_muerta_specifics: Vaca Muerta formation requires high-intensity completions due to low permeability (<0.001 mD) and complex mineralogy. Typical completions cost $3-6 million USD.
technical_notes.pressure_limitations: Max pressure limited by: (1) casing burst rating, (2) formation fracture pressure, (3) wellhead equipment rating. Overpressure can cause casing failure.
technical_notes.horsepower_requirements: Horsepower determines pump rate capability. Higher hp = higher rate = wider fractures. Limited by wellbore friction and formation acceptance.
technical_notes.water_sourcing: Water availability is major constraint in some Argentina regions. Recycling produced water becoming more common.
technical_notes.completion_types_by_play: Shale: 90%+ plug-and-perf. Tight gas: mix of plug-and-perf and sliding sleeves. Conventional: simple perforations.

data_quality_notes.missing_data: Some fields may be null/zero - not all operators report all parameters
data_quality_notes.zero_vs_null: Zero may mean 'not used' (e.g., CO2) or 'not reported'. Check context.
data_quality_notes.imported_vs_domestic: Proppant source tracking not always complete - totals more reliable than split
data_quality_notes.pressure_units: Confirm units are psi not bar or kPa - typical range check 5000-15000
data_quality_notes.lateral_length: Zero lateral length means vertical well or data not reported
